photos.c: Above: Belgrave's South of Thames Championship winning team 1999 - Rob Harding, Charlie Dickinson, Kevin Quinn, Phil Carstairs (obscured), Paul Coughlan, Roger Alsop, Mike Kazimierski, Jerome Curtat (behind), Don Anderson, Najibe Hliouat, Saul Armanini and Graham Adams. The man missing from this shot is Will Cockerell.
Right: Halfway and Paul Coughlan (20) tracks a a whole mob of runners fighting for top ten positions, including Blackheath's D. Lee (50) and Thames Hare & Hounds' Al Kennis (535).
Paul Coughlan has given everything - but will it be enough for Roger Alsop?

Right: An hour before "National" race time. Bill Laws and John Jeffery have driven back to Milton Keynes to pick up Paul Evans whose car has broken down, leaving the rest of the team to pose for the pre-race photo. Back row: Eric Hall (President), Don Anderson, Paul Coughlan, Alan Mead, Alaster Stewart, Paul Freary, Jason Lobo, Kevin Nash, Phil Carstairs, Rob Harding. Front: Darryl Ochse, Will Cockerell, Charles Herrington, Lee Hurst, Rob McHarg.
